title: Onboarding risk register and remediation slate
body:
Purpose:
A lightweight, prioritized risk register + remediation slate aimed at reducing time-to-productivity for new ICs (engineers and PMs) and decreasing first-90-day offboarding risk. This is intended to be used by hiring managers, people-ops partners, and the onboarding squad to track items that require active intervention.

Scope:
- Individual contributor hires across engineering, product, and platform teams.
- Focus on first 30 and first 90 day failure modes (knowledge gaps, tooling access, role clarity, social integration).
- Not a replacement for the full 90-day onboarding playbook; instead acts as a prioritized triage doc for the first 14 days and escalation toward 30/90.

How to use this doc (quick):
- Triage weekly in 30-min sync between hiring manager + ppl-ops partner in week 0 and week 1.
- Move items to JIRA (HR- or TEAM- prefixed tickets) when remediation requires cross-team work.
- Assign an owner and a due date for each risk.

Risk register (priority ordering, start of hire — template rows):
1) Risk: No access to critical infra (CI/GitHub org, internal VPN, private model registry)
   - Impact: Blocked on code reviews / cannot run local infra -> >7d productivity loss
   - Likelihood (initial): medium-high for external transfers and contractors
   - Owner: hiring manager (assign to eng-ops if infra blocker)
   - Mitigation actions: pre-stage access package (see checklist below); bootleg VPN token for first 72h; buddy pair to run a dev loop session on day 1
   - Status: open / action: create HR-xxxx ticket / ETA: 72h

2) Risk: Role expectations ambiguous (deliverables, scope boundaries vs. adjacent pods)
   - Impact: misaligned priorities -> rework, frustration, early resignation risk
   - Likelihood: medium
   - Owner: hiring manager + product lead
   - Mitigation: 7-day alignment doc: 3 deliverables for 30/60/90 days; 1:1s with cross-functional PMs scheduled within week 1; share top-3 metrics owner cares about
   - Status: open / action: share draft in onboarding folder / ETA: 7d

3) Risk: No assigned mentor or buddy (social isolation, slow context transfer)
   - Impact: slow ramp, knowledge smells, lower retention
   - Likelihood: medium
   - Owner: ppl-ops (match) + manager
   - Mitigation: auto-match program — 3-touch intro (day0, day3, week2) + schedule of knowledge sessions (system walkthroughs)
   - Status: in progress / action: Maya to propose pairings / ETA: day0 assignment

4) Risk: Incomplete onboarding materials for team-specific infra (docs stale)
   - Impact: lots of repeated questions for senior engineers; low confidence
   - Likelihood: high in teams with >6-month doc gap
   - Owner: manager + doc steward
   - Mitigation: documentation sprint backlog item; quick intro session where current owner screens common runbooks; attach list of 5 highest-value docs to the hire packet
   - Status: open / action: doc backlog ticket JIRA-PLAT-402 / ETA: 14d

5) Risk: Unclear success metrics for probation / performance conversations
   - Impact: surprise feedback, calibration issues at cycle review
   - Likelihood: low-medium
   - Owner: manager + people-ops
   - Mitigation: default probation rubric (see attached scoring below) + probation check-ins at weeks 3, 6, 12
   - Status: planned / action: manager to adopt rubric / ETA: week 1

6) Risk: Sensitive data access delays (customer corp data, SSO approvals, KMS)
   - Impact: cannot complete secure testing or work on compliance-limited tasks -> blocked features
   - Likelihood: medium for Private deployment work
   - Owner: security & compliance + hiring manager
   - Mitigation: Temporary shadow access with redacted datasets; escalate with security contact within 24h; include in preboarding form
   - Status: open / action: security intake SR-11 / ETA: 48h

Prioritized remediation slate (actions to run in first 14 days):
- Day -2 to 0: Pre-boarding pack sent (hardware, Slack invite, list of must-read docs, first-week calendar skeleton). Responsible: ppl-ops.
- Day 0: Welcome + intro meeting (manager, buddy, ppl-ops). Rapid infra sanity check (SSH/VPN/Git). If fail, issue short-lived access token and escalate. Responsible: manager + eng-ops.
- Day 1: Pairing session — run a full dev loop + sample PR review. Responsible: buddy.
- Day 2-4: Product/system walkthroughs (2x 45m sessions). Responsible: product lead + senior engineer.
- Day 5: Hiring manager sends 30/60/90 deliverables doc and schedule 1:1s.
- End of week 2: 30-minute triage sync (manager + ppl-ops) to close low-hanging items and open JIRA tickets for cross-team work.

Default probation rubric (copyable):
- Scoring 1–5 across dimensions (1=not demonstrated, 5=exceeds):
  - Role knowledge & technical competence
  - Ownership & delivery (meets deadlines, communicates blockers)
  - Cross-team collaboration & communication
  - Learning velocity (absorbs codebase, tooling)
  - Cultural fit (values, feedback receptivity)
- Quick pass thresholds: no dimension <2 and average >=3 by week 12 -> green. If any dim <2 at week 6 -> action plan.

Interview panel additions (to reduce mis-hires):
- Ask for 1 example of cross-team conflict and how candidate resolved it (behavioral). Score 1-5.
- Include a 15-min culture-fit micro-cook (values scenario) for senior ICs. Score: evidence of candor + constructive feedback.
- Add a 30-min 'system walkthrough' to the interview loop for infra-heavy roles: candidate reads a short runbook and proposes a small improvement; evaluates systems-thinking.
- Panel calibration note: use example answers bank (link CONFLUENCE-INTERVIEWS-174) when in doubt.

Checklist (preboarding & day0 simple checklist):
- Hardware ordered & received? (yes/no)
- Laptop image applied and admin account created
- Slack + Google workspace invites sent
- GitHub org invite ✓
- VPN/SSO test account prepared
- Manager onboarding meeting scheduled
- Buddy assigned and first pair session scheduled
- 30/60/90 deliverables doc drafted
- Security intake filed (if role accesses PII or corp data)
- Top-5 team docs attached to welcome packet

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Can we reduce infra access lead time to <48h for Dedicated/Private teams? (Ravi to pilot pre-staged tokens)
- Should we auto-create temporary sandbox datasets for compliance-sensitive roles? (Maya + security to prototype)
- Do we need a formal certification of onboarding completeness from managers at day 14 to trigger certain permissions? (pros/cons)

Notes to self / rapid items to add to central playbook:
- Add small template: "first-week dev loop script" — 30–45m step-by-step for buddy to follow, minimal cognitive overhead.
- Keep a running list of repeat JIRA tickets created during new hire ramp to identify systemic blockers.
- Add an explicit fallback: if buddy unavailable in week1 -> manager must run pairing session day1.

Appendix (copyable email to send on hire day):
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick first-day checklist
Hi {{name}},
Welcome — thrilled you've joined us. Quick checklist of what we'll do today:
- 9:00am: Manager welcome (15m)
- 9:30am: Buddy pairing (45m) — run a dev loop + PR review
- 11:00am: Infra access sanity check (eng-ops)
- 2:00pm: Product walkthrough (pm)
I've attached links to top-5 docs and the 30/60/90 deliverables doc. Reply if anything looks off.
Leah

---
This doc is intentionally compact and action-focused. Use it as the triage layer between the org-wide 90-day playbook (Confluence) and team-specific onboarding plans. Update status lines and owners after weekly triage syncs.
